# `pygeovision validate`

Check a GeoTIFF for problems before it reaches a model: nulls, data type, CRS, bounds, outliers. See
[Validation](../../data/validation.md).

## When to use it

Use it on every new source of imagery, and always before training or inference on files you did not make.

## What you get

A report with `PASSED`/`FAILED`, error and warning counts and statistics (bands, size, dtype, min/max/mean/std, NaN and zero share).

## Things to know

`for-inference` validates and auto-fixes for a given model type, writing a corrected copy; read what it changed.

## Worked examples

```bash
pygeovision validate run scene.tif
```

## Commands

```text
Usage: pygeovision validate [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Validate satellite data before model inference.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  for-inference  Validate and auto-fix data for a specific model type.
  run            Validate a GeoTIFF — check nulls, dtype, CRS, bounds, outliers.
```

### `pygeovision validate for-inference`

```text
Usage: pygeovision validate for-inference [OPTIONS] INPUT_PATH

  Validate and auto-fix data for a specific model type.

  Example:
      pygeovision validate for-inference scene.tif --model-type segmentation

Options:
  --model-type [segmentation|detection|change_detection|classification|foundation|regression]
                                  [default: segmentation]
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
```

### `pygeovision validate run`

```text
Usage: pygeovision validate run [OPTIONS] INPUT_PATH

  Validate a GeoTIFF — check nulls, dtype, CRS, bounds, outliers.

  Examples:
      pygeovision validate run scene.tif
      pygeovision validate run scene.tif --required-bands 6 --value-range 0,10000
      pygeovision validate run scene.tif --report validation.html

Options:
  --required-bands INTEGER  Minimum number of bands required.
  --value-range TEXT        Expected value range, e.g. '0,10000'.
  --target-crs TEXT         Expected CRS, e.g. EPSG:4326.
  --report TEXT             Save HTML/JSON report to this path.
  --report-fmt [html|json]  [default: html]
  --mode [strict|fix|warn]  [default: fix]
  --help                    Show this message and exit.
```
